title: The Lantern Watch
subtitle: Observation: a block, and a block tag
description: An observation task completes when the player looks at the named thing for `timer` ticks. The first task names one block, `minecraft:lantern`, and looks at it for forty ticks — two seconds, where the default is one.
The second names a block *tag*, and a tag here is the tag's own id with no `#`: `minecraft:logs`. Any log answers it.
Its line ends in a `dot`, one of the five arrowhead glyphs.
